target_customer: Large multifamily property managers and lenders that verify income and employment
problem: Rental, mortgage and loan applications need slow, fraud-prone document collection to verify income and employment.
business_model: B2B SaaS AI approval agent (Evie) for property managers, plus mortgage products

founders.name: Henson Orser
prior_employers: A proptech rental application startup (4th employee, 2 years)

founders.name: Max Ponte
founders.background_notes: YC page gives only Max; surname Ponte is from the N47 portfolio page, which lists him as a builder.

competitors.name: Argyle
competitors.what: Payroll-connection income and employment verification used by tenant screening platforms

competitors.name: Plaid Income
competitors.what: Income verification via bank and payroll connections

technical_complexity.rationale: Document fraud detection, payroll data integrations and an LLM agent over applications is hard for a small team but built from existing components.

defensibility.rationale: Integration with property manager workflows helps; payroll data and verification are available to competitors.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Well-funded verification providers already served tenant screening; Snappt later added Argyle-powered income verification in June 2024.

market_need_then: Founders cite slow, fraud-prone document collection; the product launched with large property managers RPM and BH Management as named customers on the site.

branding.domain_note: Uses twodots.com per the company site; search results also show twodots.net.

identity.mascot_or_character: Evie, the AI approval agent persona
identity.voice_and_tone: Agent persona who verifies income and makes the call in minutes

branding.brand_signature: Evie, a named AI agent character

brand_strength.rationale: The name is confusable with the Dots payouts company and the Two Dots mobile game; the Evie persona is a distinctive asset but no press on it was found.

pivots.from: Income and employment verification for lenders and property managers
pivots.to: AI approval agent (Evie) handling verification, fraud and the lease decision
pivots.why: Not stated; positioning shift visible between the launch post and the current site.

outcome_analysis: Two Dots grew from a 2022 pre-seed to a team of 28 with a reported 2024 Series A at N47 and named property manager customers. Founders had direct domain experience at Blend and a rental application startup, which fits founder market fit; amounts for later rounds are not verified.
notes: Pre-seed of $500K in Aug 2022 is from Seedtable and Crunchbase via search snippets (investors per the Crunchbase snippet). Series A: N47's page says partnered 2024, Series A, with no amount; a Startups Gallery snippet gives $10.5M on Feb 1, 2025, a single aggregator, unverified and not recorded. Competitor pages are undated and vendor authored. Evie is called Eve in another snippet. Education not found.
